dictation.unsupported: This browser cannot listen. Type the message, or open the conversation in Chrome, Edge or Safari to speak it.
dictation.notAllowed: The browser is not letting this page use the microphone. Allow it for this site in the browser, then press the mic again.
dictation.noSpeech: Nothing was heard. Press the mic and speak, or type the message instead.
dictation.audioCapture: No microphone was found. Connect one and press the mic again, or type the message instead.
dictation.network: The browser could not reach its speech service. Type the message instead, or press the mic again once the connection is back.
dictation.other: Listening stopped ({code}). Press the mic to try again, or type the message instead.

hint.emptyRoom: No one is in this conversation yet.
hint.noSuchName: No one here is called @{token}, so this message will not be answered.
hint.cutOff: {names} will answer, in that order. Paused after {count} replies, so the rest of those you named will not.

seat.ringTokens: {name} has used {used} of {max} tokens of context
seat.ringTurns: {name} has used {used} of {max} turns of context
seat.windowLoaded: The server serving this model reported this context window when it loaded it.
seat.windowPublished: The published context window for this model, which its provider enforces.
seat.activeContext: Active context: {used} / {max} tokens. Session spend: {spent} tokens.
seat.notCountedYet: Token counts are kept for the current run. This seat has not answered since it started, so nothing has been booked against it here.
seat.noWindow: No context window was reported for this model, so the ring counts turns instead of tokens.
seat.several: Each answers from its own context

sendFailure.absent: {reason} Your message is not in this conversation.
sendFailure.unconfirmed: Could not confirm whether this conversation has your message: {reason}
sendFailure.noAnswer: The app's background service didn't answer.
sendFailure.noReason: Something went wrong in the app's background service.
sendFailure.appFault: Something went wrong in the app.
